title: Don't Crash - The Zombie Game
description:
WARNING THIS GAME CRASHES WHEN YOU DIE! IT'S THE POINT OF THE GAME!
THIS IS A WORK IN PROGRESS GAME!
Welcome to the second installment of the "Don't Crash" game series!
Game features "endless" Zombie and Soldier combat, 4 levels!
As well as shotgun, pistols, assault rifles, and knife.

Key Features:
1. Game Crashes When You Die
2. Zombie and Soldier AI With Cover and Footstep Listening
3. First Person Shooting
4. Grenades, rifles, pistols, shotgun, RPG Launcher, and a knife.
5. Four Levels. Warehouse, Hospital, Mansion, and Bunker.
6. Score System
7. Hidden Easter Eggs
description_short: WARNING THIS GAME CRASHES WHEN YOU DIE! IT'S THE POINT OF THE GAME! Game features "endless" Zombie and Soldier combat, several levels As well as a shotgun, pistols, assault rifles, RPG Launcher and a knife. This is a work in progress game.
